name: Debian
body: security.txt, nosniff, a no-referrer policy, and framing limited to its origin. But the site search field on the pages analyzed has no label, aria-label, or title, so screen readers announce an unnamed field.
lesson: Add <label for> or aria-label="Search" to the field. One attribute makes it usable by voice.
summary: www.debian.org scores 83 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 19 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 38 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 38 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /intro/people, /intro/philosophy, /devel/join/ and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /intro/people, /intro/philosophy, /devel/join/, /intro/index and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /intro/people, /intro/philosophy, /devel/join/ and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 794 ms
